title: Articles 1
note: Authoring law: a/an = first time / one job·thing. the = same thing again (a X already in the gap line) OR only-one (situational). Never bare CZ alone as the only cue for the. · names from the GLUE name pool · 2026-08-06 re-lexified onto pool-legal vocabulary · 2026-08-17 MOVED from path slot 18 to slot 5 (James: articles are demanded from slot 2 and were taught 16 units late — 84 sentences owed) and re-lexified again onto the much smaller slot-5 pool, where the only verbs available are be and have. Eight words the unit must own to teach its own content are declared via `lemma`: apple, egg, hour, office, university, old, water, music. Keep them — a/an cannot be taught without a vowel-sound noun, and zero article cannot be taught without an uncountable. · 2026-08-20 (James, smoke): the 8 zero-article items had an EMPTY gap_answer, so the adapter dropped them from Quiz AND Type — zero article was taught in the intro and Match and never once drilled. Answer is now a dash; every item carries an authored 4-option set (a · an · the · —) so 'is an article needed at all?' is live on every question; +3 uncountables (bread, coffee, money) since only water and music carried that case. · RUE2 TRANSPLANT 2026-08-25: blocks+intro restored from rue2-grok-v1.0 (James-smoked, quality=unrated); auto-authored bank superseded. · 2026-08-25 four-way quiz (James): every item offers a/an/the/— ; zero-article items answer — (was empty, silently dropped from Check).

items.cz: Mám psa. (one dog — first time)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.cz: Ona je učitelka. (job → a/an + job; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: On je inženýr. (job · vowel sound → an; ne the)
items.explanation: Job + vowel sound at the start → an (engineer, artist…).

items.cz: Patrik je student. (job; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: On je doktor. (povolání → a/an + job; ne the — není to „ten konkrétní“ doktor)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: Ona je zdravotní sestra. (job → a + job; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: Ona je umělkyně. (job · vowel sound → an; ne the)
items.explanation: Job + vowel sound at the start → an (engineer, artist…).

items.cz: Potřebuju tašku. (one bag — first time)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.cz: Potřebuju nový telefon. (one phone — first time)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.en: I eat an apple every day.
items.cz: Každý den sním jablko. (one · vowel → an)
accepts: I eat an apple every day.
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.cz: Ona má staré auto. (one · vowel sound old → an)
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.cz: Čekám hodinu. (one hour · silent h → an)
items.explanation: Hour starts with a vowel sound (silent h) → an hour.

items.cz: Mám deštník. (one · vowel sound → an)
items.explanation: Umbrella starts with a vowel sound → an umbrella.

items.cz: Tohle je univerzita. (zvuk yu- → a university, ne an; první zmínka typu místa, ne the)
items.explanation: University starts with a /j/ sound ("you") → a, not an.

items.en: I have a dog. The dog is small.
items.cz: Mám psa. Ten pes je malý.
items.gap: I have a dog. ____ dog is small.
accepts: I have a dog. The dog is small.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: I have a book. The book is on the table.
items.cz: Mám knihu. Ta kniha je na stole.
items.gap: I have a book. ____ book is on the table.
accepts: I have a book. The book is on the table.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

I have a bag. The bag is blue.

items.en: There is a window. Open the window, please.
items.cz: Je tu okno. Otevři to okno, prosím. (there/here OK)
items.gap: There is a window. Open ____ window, please.
accepts: There is a window. Open the window, please.
There is a window. Open the window please.
Here is a window. Open the window, please.
Here's a window. Open the window, please.
Here is a window. Open the window, please
Here's a window. Open the window, please
There is a window. Open the window, please

cards.title: Articles · the idea
cards.body: Small words before a noun. In Czech you often say nothing — in English you usually choose **a / an**, **the**, or **nothing**.
points: Missing a/an/the before **one** person or thing is a very common error
First goal: choose the right option — use the map on the next card

cards.title: a, an, the — or nothing?
cards.body: One question first. Then the kind of noun.
points: **a / an** = one singular countable (first time / one of many)
**no article** = plurals in general, or uncountables (water, music…)

cards.title: a or an?
points: Listen to the **sound**, not only the letter
**a** + consonant sound: a bag, a teacher, a university (yoo-)
**an** + vowel sound: an apple, an engineer, an hour (silent h)

rows: a dog · a student · a new phone
an apple · an artist · an hour

cards.title: When: the (and a → the)
points: You said it before (**a** dog → **the** dog)
Only one in the situation (open **the** window · **the** sun)

cards.title: Common A1 mistakes
points: Do not leave the noun empty when you mean **one** person or thing

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: One of many (first time) → a/an. We know which → the. Plurals / uncountables often → nothing.
points: I have a book. ___ book is on the table. → **The**
Harder zero patterns (school, hospital, countries…) come later
